posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
[](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/v/family/MichaelH/Holograms/facia.jpg.html?g2_imageViewsIndex=1)

Two-color 4x6" reflection hologram on PFG-01 film.

The masters were exposed on PFG-01 film laminated to glass with Kapco. The faces are made of clay and the background is rough wood with a black circle where the faces go. Alignment still needs some work but overall came out the way I'd envisioned.

All were developed with JD-2 developer and EDTA bleach.

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md: Hey, interesting possibilities! What are these people doing inside the wood? Termite ancestor spirits? The section of red/green overlap was iintriguing too - maybe a believable wood color. Could make use of the extra color somehow...

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
> **Tom B.:** Hey, interesting possibilities! What are these people doing inside the wood? Termite ancestor spirits?

Or perhaps spirits of the wood who have come forth to protest the cutting down of the world's forests. Or both.

> **Tom B.:** The section of red/green overlap was iintriguing too - maybe a believable wood color. Could make use of the extra color somehow...

Susan's suggested I do one with the wood being yellow. Your comments give me the idea to paint the wood a dark gray (right now the black area is paper) so there will some woodgrain showing through the faces. I'll try that after my contest entry is complete.
